title: Belagavi-Born Technologist Sachin Katti Named Intel’s Chief Technology & AI Officer
summary: Sachin Katti, a Belagavi-born technologist and alumnus of IIT Bombay and MIT, has been appointed Intel’s Chief Technology & AI Officer, succeeding Greg Lavender. He will lead Intel's AI strategy, product roadmap, Intel Labs, and engagement with startups and developers as the company pushes into generative AI, HPC and edge solutions.
content:
Byuday

April 18, 2025

Katti, who hails from Belagavi and is an alumnus of St. Xavier’s High School, now joins the highest ranks at Intel, succeeding Greg Lavender, who is retiring. This marks a moment of immense pride not only for the Indian diaspora but especially for the Belagavi community.

???? A Mind Shaped in Belagavi, Polished Globally

After his schooling in Belagavi, Sachin Katti went on to complete his B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering from the prestigious IIT Bombay. He then earned his M.S. and Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), graduating in 2005 and 2009 respectively. Over the years, he has carved a reputation as a pioneer in networking systems and wireless technologies.

At Intel, Sachin Katti previously led the networking chip division and was instrumental in driving innovation across Intel’s connectivity solutions. His promotion is seen as a strategic move, as Intel seeks to regain lost ground in AI chips where competitors like Nvidia currently dominate.

???? Leading Intel’s AI Future

Lip-Bu Tan, in his internal memo, expressed full confidence in Katti’s capabilities: “Katti is expanding his responsibilities to include the role of chief technology and AI officer for the company. As part of this, he will lead our overall AI strategy and AI product roadmap, as well as Intel Labs and our relationships with the startup and developer ecosystems.”

As CTO and AI chief, Katti will steer Intel’s push into generative AI, high-performance computing, and edge solutions — areas that will define the next decade of computing. His leadership will also extend to Intel Labs, the innovation nerve center of the company, as well as its outreach to startups and the developer community.

???? Local Boy, Global Impact

For the people of Belagavi, Sachin Katti’s journey is nothing short of inspirational. From the classrooms of St. Xavier’s to the boardrooms of Silicon Valley, he exemplifies what dedication, intellect, and a strong educational foundation can achieve. His rise to one of the most critical roles in the tech industry is a reminder of the city’s quiet but impactful contribution to India’s global talent pool.

As the AI revolution gains momentum, all eyes will be on Intel — and by extension, on Katti — to see how the tech giant reinvents itself under his vision.

Source

So proud to see our student Sachin Katti from St Xavier’s High School, Belgaum take on the role of Chief Technology and AI Officer at Intel! I still remember him as an extraordinary student during his school days always curious, always hungry to learn more. He had a natural brilliance and a passion for knowledge that set him apart. Consistently standing first in class, he was never one to settle always pushing boundaries even back then.

Wishing him continued success in this incredible journey!

Congratulations and heartening to see appreciation from Lester sir ????????

Congratulations Sachin on this great achievement proud moment for all the people of Belgavi …..hats off on ur success

Really the truth has to unveil itself,otherwise future bleak.Recognising a genius is also the professional people ,Hattsoff.Thank u

All the best ????

Much needed and timely! Belagavi has been brought in the international map of tecnology by Mr Sachin. We, Belgaumites are indeed proud of him. We wish him mmuch more heights.

Great!!!Heartiest CongratulationsMr. Sachin Katti. Proud to be.Being Belgamit ..Scale High every time !!!All the best!!Stay tuned to Belgaum India Indians

Congratulations ????????????

Proud moment for Belgaumite

Congratulations and best wishes for your future

As a Kannadiga I am real proud of you. May you have a long and successful career.

But he is now US citizen, no more Indian.  If he is in India and got this role at Bangalore then it’s a proud moment.

I don’t think it’s a moment for celebration, he can’t help people of Belgaum

Please grow up Raju Prasad and get a life, making such an uncalled comment on our local boy Sachin Katti’s success doesn’t give you any professional credibility.  Thanks

Grow up Mr Raju Prasad and get a life, making such a shameful comment on our local boy Sachin Katti’s success.

Congratulations Sachin. God Bless You..
